title: Trust domain codes come from the value set
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 2.1 Subclaims defined in this guide; Trust Domains; GDHCN Trust Domain value set.

statements.label: Trust domain codes come from the value set
statements.requirement: Trust domain codes (currently DDCC, IPS-PILGRIMAGE, PH4H, ICVP) SHALL be treated as data loaded from, or checked against, the GDHCN Trust Domain value set. They SHALL NOT be a closed enum.

sources.quote: The registered production trust domains are DDCC, IPS-PILGRIMAGE, PH4H and ICVP.
